.. change::
    :tags: documentation, postgresql
    :tickets: 9944

    Added a PostgreSQL-specific recipe using
    :meth:`.PGInspector.get_foreign_table_names` and explicit
    :class:`.Table` reflection, allowing foreign tables to be loaded into a
    :class:`.MetaData` collection without broadening the generic
    :meth:`.MetaData.reflect` table-enumeration contract.
